name: figma-code-connect-utilities
description: Utility scripts for Figma Code Connect configuration and component data extraction

scripts.workflow:complete: npm run fetch:components && npm run build:config:file
scripts.workflow:chakra: npm run fetch:components && npm run setup:chakra
scripts.dev:check: node -c scripts/buildFigmaConfig.js && node -c scripts/fetchComponents.js && node -c scripts/extractComponentProps.js && echo '✅ All scripts syntax OK'
scripts.workflow:props: npm run extract:props && echo 'Component props extracted to components-props/ directory'
scripts.workflow:full: npm run fetch:components && npm run build:config:file && npm run extract:props
scripts.help: echo 'Available commands:' && echo '' && echo 'Fetch Components:' && echo '  npm run fetch:components     - Extract components from Figma' && echo '  npm run fetch:help          - Show fetch options' && echo '' && echo 'Build Configuration:' && echo '  npm run build:config        - Generate config (console)' && echo '  npm run build:config:file   - Generate config file' && echo '  npm run build:config:help   - Show build options' && echo '' && echo 'Extract Component Props:' && echo '  npm run extract:props        - Extract all component props' && echo '  npm run extract:props:preview - Preview extraction (dry-run)' && echo '  npm run extract:props:help   - Show extraction options' && echo '  npm run extract:accordion    - Extract accordion components' && echo '  npm run extract:button       - Extract button components' && echo '  npm run extract:overwrite    - Extract with overwrite' && echo '' && echo 'Quick Setups:' && echo '  npm run setup:chakra        - Chakra UI style config' && echo '  npm run setup:basic         - Basic design system config' && echo '' && echo 'Complete Workflows:' && echo '  npm run workflow:complete   - Fetch + Generate config' && echo '  npm run workflow:chakra     - Fetch + Chakra setup' && echo '  npm run workflow:props      - Extract component props' && echo '  npm run workflow:full       - Full pipeline (Figma + Config + Props)' && echo '' && echo 'Development:' && echo '  npm run dev:preview         - Preview config (no file)' && echo '  npm run dev:check           - Check script syntax' && echo '' && echo 'For detailed usage, see scripts/README.md'
